scope: added an evidence audit tool and repaired the one corrupt record it found

checks: records carry schema and scope (informational: legacy records predate the convention)
records are referenced by one of the six main documents (informational)
strict mode turns missing fields and unreferenced records into failures

defect_repaired.problem: a dangling `"next",` key with no value made the whole record invalid JSON
defect_repaired.fix: replaced with `"next": [],` - the record now parses and keeps all its content

policy: invalid JSON fails the audit (a broken record cannot be cited)
legacy records without schema/scope are reported but not fatal, because 769 predate the convention and rewriting them would fabricate metadata
strict mode is available for future cleanup
why_it_matters: the evidence trail is the project's main claim to rigor; a corrupt record silently weakens it
the audit runs in about a second and can be part of any future check
